channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Two children killed in drone strike in southern Russia
item.description:
Two children were killed in a drone strike in southern Russia, local media reported.
According to the reports, nine other people, including seven children, were injured by shrapnel that struck a private pediatric care center.

item.title: Russia: Drone attacks industrial zone in Nevinnomyssk
item.description:
Russian authorities reported that a drone attacked the industrial zone in the city of Nevinnomyssk in the Stavropol region in southern Russia. Regional Governor Vladimir Vladimirov said: “Russia is repelling the attack on the industrial zone."
Reuters noted that the area is used, among other purposes, for chemical production and is also home to several other industrial facilities.

item.title: Ukraine: Three killed in Russian strike on outskirts of Kharkiv
item.description:
Three people were killed in a Russian strike on the outskirts of Kharkiv in northeastern Ukraine, the regional governor said.
Emergency crews rescued eight people from the area, some of whom were injured.

item.title: EU condemns Israel's E1 construction plans: Damage to two-state solution
item.description: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas condemns Israel's E1 construction plans, saying the project would undermine prospects for a two-state solution.

item.title: Netanyahu orders Eisenkot to receive 'adequate security, as needed'
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the issue of security for Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot and instructed Shin Bet (Israel Security Agency) Director David Zini to ensure that Eisenkot receives security “at an adequate level, as needed."
The Shin Bet told Netanyahu that it is “doing everything possible" and is “acting in accordance with the law."

item.title: US envoy walks back Golan remarks: Trump's policy remains unchanged
item.description: US envoy Tom Barrack walks back remarks that Israel “still" occupies the Golan Heights, stressing that Trump's 2019 recognition remains US policy.

item.title: Civil Administration rescues three Israelis who entered Palestinian Authority areas
item.description:
The Civil Administration rescued three Israelis in recent hours after they entered areas under Palestinian Authority control: an armed Jewish man who accidentally entered the village of Ein Arik in the Binyamin region, a Jewish woman who deliberately entered Jericho, and an Israeli described as being in an unstable mental state who was spotted in the streets of Bethlehem.
The Civil Administration stressed: “Entering Area A is life-threatening and prohibited by law."

item.title: Two European Parliament members barred from entering Israel
item.description: Foreign Minister Sa’ar asks the Population and Immigration Authority to prevent entry to Swedish lawmakers who were scheduled to land in Israel en route to the Palestinian Authority.

item.title: Watch: Muay Thai and kickboxing fighter Ahavat Hashem Gordon gets married
item.description: Muay Thai and kickboxing fighter Ahavat Hashem Gordon marries Oren Levy in Hadera.

item.title: "Battle of Civilization Versus Barbarism"
item.description: Peace becomes impossible when a public culture rewards the sacrifice of children more than the protection of their future. Opinion.

item.title: YouTube prices jump in Israel as Google hikes subscription fees
item.description: Israeli YouTube users are about to pay more, with Premium subscriptions rising by roughly 25% and YouTube Music also getting a price increase.

item.title: Costly prank: Ordered 300 Pizzas - and could be sent to prison for 8 years?
item.description: A Polish citizen ordered 300 pizzas to the homes of local residents and politicians while impersonating them.

item.title: Kushner's extraordinary warning to Hamas
item.description: Jared Kushner reportedly met Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Cairo after US intelligence indicated that some Hamas officials were planning to violate commitments to disarm.

item.title: New poll shakes up race as Netanyahu bloc falls further behind
item.description: A new poll puts Gadi Eisenkot ahead of Likud, while the anti-Netanyahu bloc leads the right by six seats - and a new political contender could widen the gap.

item.title: Netanyahu warns Hamas to stop Gaza drone launches or face action
item.description: Netanyahu warns Hamas that continued drone, kite and balloon launches from Gaza will trigger intensified IDF action, including strikes on launch sites and operators.

item.title: Report: Mossad chief meets with Syrian Foreign Minister
item.description: A rare meeting was held between Mossad Director Roman Gofman and Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani in an effort to ease tensions and prevent a security escalation.

item.title: Shocking footage: Mafia leader shot dead at gas station near Caesarea
item.description: A known criminal, approximately 45 years old, was shot at a gas station near Caesarea and critically wounded. He later died of his wounds. Police have opened an investigation.

item.title: Commander of Hamas weapons production site killed
item.description: Earlier today, the IDF and the ISA struck in the Maghazi area in the Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Ismail Abu Ful, a commander at a weapons manufacturing site within Hamas’ production headquarters.

item.title: After hours-long manhunt: Terrorist who stabbed Israeli in Jordan Valley captured
item.description: The 16-year-old terrorist who stabbed and moderately wounded Elhcanan Hanania was captured following an IDF manhunt in the village of al-Auja, where he carried out the attack.

item.title: Netanyahu: We will address the drone threat from the Gaza Strip
item.description: Prime Minister addresses the developing threat of explosive drones on the southern front in a special video. “I have instructed that everything be done against these deadly devices."

item.title: Report: Terrorist attempts to steal soldier's weapon at Rimonim Square
item.description:
A short while ago, a report was received regarding an attempt by a terrorist to steal a weapon from an IDF soldier in the area of Rimonim Square.
The soldier fired toward the terrorist, who was neutralized. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the scene

item.title: Force 100 soldier outraged: “Crimes were committed here"
item.description: Meir Ben Shitrit is furious over reports of a plea deal with Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi: “This time you will not whitewash the Force 100 affair."

item.title: Kidnapping and murder solved decades later
item.description: In an attack by an Arab gang during the Great Arab Revolt on the home of the Lazarevich family, members of the family were kidnapped; the three adults were murdered, and the children were released.

item.title: Dramatic shift for.the Temple Mount?
item.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu, Chief Rabbi of Tzfat, stated 'We are working on building a synagogue on the Temple Mount.'

item.title: Solberg orders Deri and Shas to remove video
item.description: Central Elections Committee chairman orders Shas and Aryeh Deri to remove a video featuring a religious soldier. The decision followed a petition by Eisenkot’s party.

item.title: The Tehran regime hasn’t changed - its old enforcers are back in power
item.description: No regime change has taken place in Tehran. America’s longtime enemies and veterans of the Islamic Republic’s machinery of violence are back at the commanding heights of power-and Iran is entering a new age of hard-line rule. Opinion.

item.title: Who’s afraid of the Big Red Scare?
item.description: We are. Dark forces infiltrate every breach in the USA, widening them through chaos, migration and party infiltration until power concentrates in the hands of a few and there is no way back to the gardens that grew its distinct beauty. Opinion.

item.title: Intruder breaks into Knesset, caught near Speaker's office
item.description: An intruder broke into the Knesset compound overnight and managed to enter the building. He was caught sitting near the office of Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana.
